documents.name: Gardaland
documents.summary: Gardaland is a theme park destination in Castelnuovo del Garda, retained for distinctive visitor-experience quality.
documents.whyWorthwhile: Italy’s most complete destination theme park, with strong family coverage and enough thrill depth for mixed-age groups.

documents.name: Ostia Antica Archaeological Park
documents.summary: A vast, unusually legible Roman port city where streets, apartments, baths, warehouses, temples, shops and a theatre form one coherent archaeological world.
documents.whyWorthwhile: Urban scale, preservation and freedom to explore make this one of Europe’s most immersive archaeological destinations.

coreExperience.note: The physical city is legible on its own, but interpretation materially deepens it.

footwear.label: Use sturdy walking shoes
footwear.note: Ancient paving and uneven archaeological surfaces are extensive.

heat.label: Plan for heat and limited shade
heat.note: Water and sun protection matter in warm weather.

coverImage.alt: Ancient streets and ruins within the Ostia Antica archaeological city

documents.name: Stelvio Pass Road — Bormio to Prato
documents.summary: A 44.6 km SS38 crossing from Bormio over the 2,758 m Stelvio Pass to Prato allo Stelvio.
documents.whyWorthwhile: Both sides are individually exceptional: the more enclosed Bormio approach contrasts with the exposed wall of switchbacks above Trafoi, producing a complete cross-pass journey rather than a one-sided climb.

coverImage.alt: The Bormio side of Stelvio Pass winding through bare high-alpine terrain.

documents.name: Italia in Miniatura
documents.summary: Italia in Miniatura is a miniature world destination in Rimini, retained for distinctive visitor-experience quality.
documents.whyWorthwhile: A large, long-running miniature Italy with interactive features and enough scale to work as a family attraction rather than a brief model display.
